selection_precondition: a compatible selected surface/curve profile as declared by the owner; no geometry is produced by the UI
units_and_options: canonical millimetres; options must be owner-declared and parsed before mutation
undo_transaction_policy: one command session = one transaction; disabled/refused/cancel writes nothing
dialog_result_mapping: Matrix Surface menu and command line resolve to this one command id; a disabled row reports the reason and never mutates
